summary.text: Zac Haines is the Republican candidate for Ohio State Senate District 7 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Cara Jacob.
He is a business owner and president.

paragraphs.text: Zac Haines earned a bachelor's degree from Miami University in 2005.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said a family-owned small buying group grew under his leadership into an international organization representing more than $2 billion in purchasing power and more than 1,700 companies.
He said he was appointed to Miami University's Board of Trustees in 2018.
Haines listed lowering property taxes, energy bills and healthcare costs, supporting law enforcement, and cutting government waste among his key campaign messages.
